Name: Axolotl Village Intro Quest Perfection Removal
Author: viccallan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fix so Axolotl's wont be included in the introduction quest and maybe perfection. Only works for new saves. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Don't install this if you want to include the Axolotl's in perfection. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This fix only changes the \Axolotl Village\[CP] Axolotl Village\Data\NPCData\Dispositions.json[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. SMAPI[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Axolotl Village[/color][/size]
3. This mod. :) say yes to replacing the Dispositions.json file if asked.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fix so Axolotl's wont be included in the introduction quest and maybe perfection. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Added these lines of code to each of the 3 characters that are not able to be met until you increase friendship with the others.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lotus, Shiso and Kandi [/color]
[code]"SocialTab": "HiddenUntilMet",
"IntroductionsQuest": false,
"PerfectionScore": false,[/code]
[color=#D4D4D8]changed the following on all character[/color]
[code]"ExcludeFromPerfectionScore"
"ExcludeFromIntroductionsQuest"[/code]to
[code]"IntroductionsQuest": false,
"PerfectionScore": false,[/code][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177391248]otohimexoxo[/url] has full permission to take this fix. 

[b][size=4]Existing saves[/size][/b]

I suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] to set the friendship to have been talked to, the very left of the first heart. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20431]Axolotl Village[/url] [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

[/color]
